title.zh: 韩国扩大HBM和先进封装投资，AI芯片竞争进一步转向产能、能源和供应链协同
title.en: South Korea expands HBM and advanced-packaging investment, shifting AI-chip competition toward capacity and coordination

summary.zh: 韩国公布由政府、三星和SK海力士共同推进的大规模半导体投资计划，重点包括新的存储器工厂和高带宽存储器封装设施。行业意义不只是增加晶圆产能，而是AI芯片竞争开始同时受制于洁净室建设、电力和用水、先进封装、设备交付以及人才供应。对数据中心和基础设施行业，芯片供应链的空间布局会继续影响服务器交付、资本开支和能源需求，单纯比较芯片设计性能已经不足以判断产业优势。
summary.en: South Korea has announced a large government-industry semiconductor investment plan with Samsung and SK hynix, including new memory fabs and high-bandwidth-memory packaging facilities. The signal is not only more wafer capacity: AI-chip competition is constrained by cleanroom construction, power and water, advanced packaging, equipment delivery, and skilled labour. For data-centre and infrastructure markets, the geography of chip supply will continue to affect server delivery, capital expenditure, and energy demand; chip design performance alone is no longer enough to judge industrial advantage.

watch.zh: 关注HBM扩产能否同步解决先进封装、能源资源和设备交付的瓶颈。
watch.en: Watch whether HBM expansion resolves advanced packaging, energy resources, and equipment-delivery bottlenecks together.

title.zh: 欧洲电池制造融资进入量产爬坡阶段，工厂工程与质量体系成为产业政策的落点
title.en: European battery funding is targeting the production ramp, making factory engineering and quality systems the practical bottleneck

summary.zh: 欧盟Battery Booster Facility为电池电芯制造项目提供最高15亿欧元无息贷款，支持从中试生产到商业化运行之间的关键阶段。对于电池行业，真正困难往往不是宣布一条产线，而是稳定地达到良率、热安全、材料一致性和交付要求。工程团队需要把洁净环境、热管理、消防分区、危险品控制、电力质量和设备维护组合成可持续运营系统。产业政策若能降低爬坡阶段的资金风险，欧洲电池供应链可能获得更多本地化建设机会。
summary.en: The EU Battery Booster Facility offers up to €1.5 billion in interest-free loans for battery-cell manufacturing projects during the critical transition from pilot production to commercial operation. The hard part is not announcing a line but consistently achieving yield, thermal safety, material consistency, and delivery requirements. Engineering teams must integrate clean environments, thermal management, fire zoning, hazardous-material controls, power quality, and equipment maintenance into an operating system. If policy reduces ramp-up financing risk, Europe may create more opportunities for a localised battery supply chain.

watch.zh: 关注获得融资的项目能否公开良率、热安全和规模化交付的工程证据。
watch.en: Watch whether funded projects publish engineering evidence for yield, thermal safety, and scaled delivery.

title.zh: 2026年研究重新强调土和基础会改变结构抗震需求，固定基模型并非总是保守
title.en: 2026 research reinforces that soil and foundations reshape seismic demand, so fixed-base models are not always conservative

summary.zh: Scientific Reports发表研究，分析不同土层条件下钢筋混凝土框架—剪力墙体系的土—基础—结构相互作用和倒塌能力。研究指出，土的非线性、基础行为以及墙体和框架之间的地震力分配会共同改变结构响应。对工程实践的提醒是，固定基假设虽然便于设计，但在软土、浅基础、地下室或基础转动明显时，可能无法反映真实周期、阻尼和地震需求。SSI分析不能机械套用，必须结合场地、基础形式和模型验证。
summary.en: A 2026 Scientific Reports study examines soil–foundation–structure interaction and collapse capacity in reinforced-concrete frame–wall systems under different soil conditions. It shows that nonlinear soil and foundation behaviour, together with redistribution of seismic forces between walls and frames, can change structural response. The practical reminder is that fixed-base assumptions are convenient but may miss the real period, damping, and demand where soft soil, shallow foundations, basements, or foundation rocking are important. SSI analysis should be evidence-based and tied to site, foundation type, and model validation.

watch.zh: 关注项目是否明确说明固定基模型的适用边界，以及何时需要土—基础—结构联合分析。
watch.en: Watch whether projects state the fixed-base boundary and when coupled soil–foundation–structure analysis is required.

referenceLinks.label: Scientific Reports: Seismic behaviour with soil–structure interaction

title.zh: 基础不是结构模型的边界条件注释，而是可能改变周期、阻尼和破坏机制的参与系统
title.en: The foundation is not a boundary-condition footnote; it can participate in period, damping, and failure mechanisms

insights.evidence: 2026 Scientific Reports study of dual reinforced-concrete systems under varying soil conditions

summary.zh: 在软土、浅基础、地下室或基础转动明显的工程中，土—基础—结构相互作用可能改变地震输入、结构周期、阻尼和墙框分担。Scientific Reports的2026年研究将土的非线性和基础行为纳入双重钢筋混凝土体系评估，说明固定基模型并不总是保守。对结构工程师，未来能力不仅是选择一个分析软件，而是判断场地和基础柔度是否足以改变设计结论，并能把地勘、基础刚度、接触非线性和结构模型统一起来。SSI结果对土参数和边界假设敏感，不能脱离现场勘察和模型校核直接使用。
summary.en: In soft soil, shallow foundations, basements, or cases with significant foundation rotation, soil–foundation–structure interaction can change input motion, period, damping, and wall–frame force sharing. A 2026 Scientific Reports study incorporates nonlinear soil and foundation behaviour into assessment of dual reinforced-concrete systems, showing that a fixed-base model is not always conservative. Future structural engineers need to judge when foundation flexibility changes the design conclusion and connect geotechnical data, foundation stiffness, contact nonlinearity, and the structural model. SSI results remain sensitive to soil parameters and boundary assumptions and cannot be used without field and model verification.

caveat.zh: SSI建模对土体参数、基础接触和地震输入敏感；复杂模型不等于更可靠，关键是假设是否有证据支持。
caveat.en: SSI models are sensitive to soil parameters, foundation contact, and seismic input; a more complex model is not automatically more reliable without supported assumptions.

insights.reference: Scientific Reports and University of Bristol soil–foundation research

referenceLinks.label: Scientific Reports: Soil–structure interaction and collapse capacity
University of Bristol: Earthquake engineering research

title.zh: 收缩徐变正在从长期变形修正项变成施工、裂缝和体系刚度的共同设计问题
title.en: Shrinkage and creep are becoming a shared design problem for construction, cracking, and system stiffness

insights.evidence: University of Queensland structural engineering research on creep and shrinkage of concrete structures

summary.zh: 混凝土收缩徐变会影响预应力损失、长期挠度、约束裂缝、内力重分配和复合结构的长期协同工作。UQ结构工程研究将收缩徐变、早龄期行为、火灾和低碳高性能混凝土放在同一材料与结构研究框架内，反映出长期性能不能只在竣工验算阶段补一个系数。对工程师而言，重要能力是把配合比、养护、施工分段、约束条件、环境湿度和构件刚度一起考虑。模型预测需要试验或现场数据校准，尤其是低碳胶凝材料不能直接套用传统经验参数。
summary.en: Concrete shrinkage and creep affect prestress loss, long-term deflection, restraint cracking, force redistribution, and composite action. UQ’s structural research places creep, shrinkage, early-age behaviour, fire, and low-carbon high-performance concrete within one materials-and-structures framework, reflecting that long-term performance cannot be handled as a coefficient added at completion. Engineers need to connect mix design, curing, construction sequence, restraint, humidity, and member stiffness. Predictions require testing or field calibration, especially when low-carbon binders do not follow traditional empirical parameters.

caveat.zh: 收缩徐变参数受材料、龄期、湿度、构件尺寸和施工历史影响显著；长期预测应明确校准范围。
caveat.en: Shrinkage and creep parameters depend strongly on materials, age, humidity, member size, and construction history; long-term predictions need an explicit calibration range.

insights.reference: University of Queensland concrete and structural research

area.zh: 震后火灾与跨灾种评估

title.zh: 结构风险评估正在从单一灾害脆弱性转向连续灾害和功能恢复路径
title.en: Structural risk assessment is moving from single-hazard fragility toward sequential hazards and recovery paths

insights.evidence: 2026 research on cross-hazard damage measures for sequential earthquake–fire events

summary.zh: 震后火灾不是把地震损伤和火灾损伤简单相加。地震造成的裂缝、残余变形、连接损伤和非结构系统失效，可能改变后续火灾中的边界、荷载路径和材料保护；反过来火灾又会降低构件刚度、强度和可修复性。2026年研究提出面向连续地震—火灾事件的跨灾种损伤度量，说明未来结构工程需要同时处理损伤状态、残余性能和恢复决策。局限是连续灾害数据不足，模型结果应明确采用的情景顺序和脆弱性假设。
summary.en: Post-earthquake fire is not a simple sum of earthquake and fire damage. Cracking, residual drift, connection damage, and non-structural failures caused by an earthquake can change boundaries, load paths, and protection during a subsequent fire; fire can then reduce stiffness, strength, and repairability. 2026 research proposes a cross-hazard damage measure for sequential earthquake–fire events, showing that future structural engineering must address damage state, residual performance, and recovery decisions together. Data for sequential hazards remain limited, so the event sequence and fragility assumptions must be explicit.

caveat.zh: 跨灾种模型对事件顺序和损伤累积假设敏感，研究框架不能直接替代项目级火灾、抗震和修复设计。
caveat.en: Cross-hazard models are sensitive to event sequence and cumulative-damage assumptions; research frameworks do not replace project-level fire, seismic, and repair design.

title.zh: 基础不是固定支座：中国与国际设计如何处理土—结构相互作用？
title.en: A foundation is not a fixed support: how Chinese and international design treat soil–structure interaction

text.zh: 土—结构相互作用的核心是：结构、基础和土体会共同变形，基础并不是分析模型中天然不动的固定支座。中国、澳洲、美国和欧洲设计体系虽然在场地分类、地基刚度、基础转动、地震输入和简化方法上使用不同术语，但共同面对三个问题：土体是否会改变输入运动，基础柔度是否会改变结构周期，以及接触、滑移或摇摆是否会改变受力路径。对普通刚性基础，固定基模型可能足够；对软土、深基础、地下室、浅基础摇摆或高柔结构，土—基础—结构模型可能成为设计判断的一部分。重点不是模型越复杂越好，而是假设是否由地勘、试验和敏感性分析支持。
text.en: The core of soil–structure interaction is that the structure, foundation, and soil deform together; a foundation is not naturally a motionless fixed support in an analytical model. Chinese, Australian, US, and European systems use different terms for site classification, foundation stiffness, rotation, seismic input, and simplified methods, but all face three questions: does the soil modify the input motion, does foundation flexibility change the structural period, and do contact, sliding, or rocking change the load path? A fixed-base model may be adequate for ordinary stiff foundations, while soft soil, deep foundations, basements, shallow-foundation rocking, or flexible structures may require coupled reasoning. Complexity is not the objective; evidence-supported assumptions are.

label.zh: 场地不是输入文件里的一个数字
label.en: The site is more than one input number

text.zh: 土层刚度、阻尼、非线性和地下水会影响地震波传播与基础响应，场地分类不能替代工程判断。
text.en: Soil stiffness, damping, nonlinearity, and groundwater affect wave propagation and foundation response; a site class does not replace engineering judgement.

label.zh: 基础柔度会改变结构周期

text.zh: 当基础转动或平动不可忽略时，结构周期、层间变形和地震力分配都可能偏离固定基模型。
text.en: When foundation rotation or translation is significant, period, drift, and seismic-force distribution may depart from a fixed-base model.

label.zh: 简化模型需要边界证明

text.zh: 固定基、等效弹簧或完全耦合模型都可以是工具，但应说明适用范围、敏感参数和不确定性。
text.en: Fixed-base, equivalent-spring, and fully coupled models can all be useful, but their scope, sensitive parameters, and uncertainty should be stated.

takeaway.zh: 中外设计体系的共同底层逻辑不是规定一个统一的基础刚度，而是判断土和基础是否足以改变结构需求；当答案为是，基础就必须进入结构性能论证。
takeaway.en: The shared logic across design systems is not one universal foundation stiffness; it is deciding whether soil and foundation behaviour can change structural demand. When the answer is yes, the foundation belongs in the performance argument.

title.zh: 参考实例：固定基与柔性基础的等效周期概念筛查
title.en: Worked reference: conceptual period screening for fixed-base and flexible-foundation models

intro.zh: 以下关系是基本动力学和等效刚度概念的派生关系，不是某一规范的编号公式。正式设计应按适用规范确定土参数、基础刚度、地震输入、接触条件、阻尼、非线性和模型验证。
intro.en: The relations below are derived from basic dynamics and equivalent-stiffness concepts; they are not numbered equations from one standard. Formal design must determine soil parameters, foundation stiffness, seismic input, contact, damping, nonlinearity, and validation under the applicable provisions.

label.zh: 固定基体系的概念周期（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：以质量m和上部结构刚度kₛ表达固定基理想化周期；不是规范编号公式。
citation.en: Derived relation: expresses an idealised fixed-base period using mass m and superstructure stiffness kₛ; it is not a numbered code equation.

label.zh: 结构与基础串联等效刚度（派生关系）
label.en: Series equivalent stiffness of structure and foundation (derived relation)

citation.zh: Derived relation：用串联系统说明基础柔度如何降低整体等效刚度；真实土—基础系统通常还包含转动、阻尼和非线性。
citation.en: Derived relation: illustrates how foundation flexibility reduces total stiffness in a series system; real soil–foundation systems also involve rotation, damping, and nonlinearity.

label.zh: 等效模型利用系数筛查

citation.zh: Simplified screen：表示设计作用效应与设计抗力的比值；η不是土—结构相互作用的通用验收常数，具体限值必须按适用规范确定。
citation.en: Simplified screen: ratio of design action effect to design resistance. η is not a universal soil–structure interaction acceptance constant; limits must come from the applicable standard.

note.zh: 例如，若质量m=1,000 t、上部结构刚度kₛ=4,000 kN/m、基础刚度k𝒇=4,000 kN/m，则串联等效刚度kₑ=2,000 kN/m，相比固定基模型降低；这通常会使概念周期增长，但地震需求变化仍需结合场地和阻尼分析。
note.en: For example, with mass m=1,000 t, superstructure stiffness kₛ=4,000 kN/m, and foundation stiffness k𝒇=4,000 kN/m, the series equivalent stiffness is kₑ=2,000 kN/m, lower than the fixed-base idealisation. The conceptual period therefore increases, but the change in seismic demand still requires site and damping analysis.
